opening_thought: Cold stone. Blue light that doesn't flicker. REST — still point in darkness, end of searching. Or: the year I stopped answering and called exhaustion wisdom.

thoughts.lesson_3_cavern: Rest. Even the crystal stops humming when I stop fighting the dark. I rested from people until rest became a cave.
thoughts.cavern_crystal_musings: Light trapped in mineral — patient, unhurried. Like messages on my phone I never opened.
thoughts.cavern_clue_musings: REST carved in the pillar. Delusion: sacred halt. Memory: unread texts, a friend still waiting, me asleep at noon for months.

cavern_clue_found.title: Etched Pillar
cavern_clue_found.body: Four letters in stone: REST. Third chapter of the inner worlds. Or the word on the safe note — handle where you rest — finally pointing at a person, not a pillow.

lesson_3_cavern.title: Lesson — Rest
lesson_3_cavern.body: Stone chest opened to REST. Wardrobe in the bedroom may yield now. You rested from guilt until guilt became geology.

cavern_crystal.title: Crystal Cluster
cavern_crystal.body: Blue facets catching light from nowhere. Pulse like slow breathing — or notification vibrations you learned to ignore.

cavern_clue.title: Etched Stone
cavern_clue.body: REST carved deep. The cavern agrees with the safe scrap, the bed, the collapse — same word, two tracks.

cavern_chest.title: Stone Chest
cavern_chest.body: Heavy lid, letter lock. Quiet until you solve it — same silence you offered everyone who knocked.

ending.title: Rest
ending.body: The crystals dim. REST walks back to the bedroom with you — not surrender, or surrender to remembering.
